# LinkedIn Profile Scraper for cheap lead enrichment ✅

The Apify actor [`anchor/linkedin-profile-enrichment`](https://apify.com/anchor/linkedin-profile-enrichment) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.16.2**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract LIVE LinkedIn profile data from LinkedIn URLs. Works with people and companies. Upload a CSV of LinkedIn URLs or use the API. Automate your LinkedIn enrichment with N8N, Make, Zapier integrations... No Cookies. Cheap, high-quality, live lead enrichment for LinkedIn profiles !

## Pricing

Pay per event — Profile Enriched $0.006, Actor Start $0.001, Actor Long Run $0.003 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/anchor/linkedin-profile-enrichment) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array |  |  | 🔎 LinkedIn URLs : Person 🫂 or Company 🏛️ — LinkedIn URLs you want to enrich. You can upload a CSV file if you want, in the format: url,id (id is useful for reference to re-import in your database) |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
